dmitri (Acme AI): Hey folks — our nightly index job started failing after the pinned model change last night. Pinecone upserts error with 'vector dimension mismatch'. Our pipeline expects 1536 dims but the embeddings returned are 2048. We pinned 'embed-clarity' to avoid drift; did the pinned version move?

maya (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, @dmitri. Can you paste the exact model field you used in the embeddings call and an example request/response (sanitized)? Also roughly how many vectors were affected and whether you used batching.

dmitri (Acme AI): Model field in our code: `model: "embed-clarity"` (we pinned via the console to that alias). Example request (sanitized):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-clarity","input":["hello world"],"user":"acme-prod"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings
```
Response (truncated):
```
{"object":"list","data":[{"object":"embedding","embedding":[0.0124, 0.0011, ... <2048 floats> ... , -0.007], "index":0}], "model":"embed-clarity-v2","usage":{...}}
```
We validated count: vector length = 2048. We have ~2.6M vectors indexed previously at 1536, so upserts crash. :sweat:

maya (Support): Thanks. Can you confirm the API key owner or customer id (just last 6 of customer id or team name is fine)? We'll pull request logs. Also, did you create the pin via the Console "Pin model" button or via API?

dmitri (Acme AI): Console -> Project -> Models -> Pin. Team=acme-prod-01.

deploy-bot: Model "embed-clarity" alias was pointed at "embed-clarity-v2" during automated promotion by release-ci at 2026-03-02T23:14:02Z.

elle (ML Eng): tagging in. This looks like a model family upgrade where the new variant (v2) uses a different embedding head / hidden size. Pinned alias should normally be immutable, but we saw a regress in the pinning pipeline last week where alias promotion sometimes picked up a newer model if the pin was created before the promotion completed.

jorge (SRE): We're seeing the same pattern in our logs for the acme-prod-01 project — the pin object attached to that project points to an alias rather than an immutable model id. The release pipeline promoted alias->v2. We're opening infra ticket INF-4529 to fix pin immutability.

maya (Support): For immediate mitigation, two options: 1) rollback the alias to the older model id (we can do this from infra side only) so your calls return 1536-dim vectors again, OR 2) migrate your index to accept 2048 dims (create new index and re-ingest). Which do you prefer?

dmitri (Acme AI): We need minimal downtime — rollback preferred if it's quick. Re-ingesting 2.6M vectors will take >12 hours and it's our production search.

elle (ML Eng): We can do a targeted rollback of the pin for acme-prod-01 and add a safety check to prevent alias promotions on pinned namespaces. I'll coordinate with infra. Workaround if you want to proceed yourself: set `model: "embed-clarity-v1"` explicitly in your request (that will hit the older vector size) until we rollback. But beware rate keys scoped to alias may still route differently.

maya (Support): @dmitri — Can you confirm you can switch to explicit model id for a quick test? If that works we'll perform a rollback and confirm.

dmitri (Acme AI): Tried `embed-clarity-v1` — returns 1536 vector as expected. Test upsert to a small test index worked.

maya (Support): Good. We'll schedule the rollback now. ETA ~30-45m. We'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollback action started by infra-ops at 2026-03-03T00:12:11Z for project acme-prod-01 (repoint alias embed-clarity -> embed-clarity-v1).

jorge (SRE): Rollback completed at 2026-03-03T00:23:04Z. Pin now points to embed-clarity-v1 (model id immutable). We also applied a temporary guard to block promotions on pinned aliases. Monitoring for 15m.

maya (Support): Can you re-run your index upsert job against production alias now? It should return 1536 and succeed (or you can continue using explicit `embed-clarity-v1`).

dmitri (Acme AI): Re-ran the job — looks good. Upserts accepted, index healthy. THANK YOU.

elle (ML Eng): Follow-ups: we'll (a) fix the pinning pipeline so pins reference immutable model ids, (b) add an automated test to catch vector-size changes on alias promotions, and (c) postmortem INF-4529 with root cause and timeline.

maya (Support): We're keeping this thread open until postmortem is published. I'll DM you the incident reference and the rollback logs. Apologies for the disruption, and thanks for the quick repro steps that helped us rollback safely. :heart:

dmitri (Acme AI): Appreciate the fast response. Please let us know once postmortem is up.

maya (Support): Will do — closing here once INF-4529 postmortem link is available.
